**Revenue Growth**  
Cisco’s revenue has shown volatility recently, with a 10.6% increase in 2023, a -5.6% decline in 2024, and a projected rebound to mid-single digit growth in the following years (CAGR of 5.3% through 2027E). This pattern reflects sensitivity to market cycles, but also signals a return to steady growth in the medium term.

**Gross Profit Margin**  
Gross profit margins (Contribution Margin) have remained robust and are expected to improve, rising from 62.5% in 2022 to an estimated 67.5% by 2027E. This indicates Cisco’s continued ability to maintain pricing power and operational efficiency in its core business.

**SG&A Expense Margin**  
SG&A expenses as a percentage of revenue have been relatively stable, peaking at 24.6% in 2025 before declining to 21.1% by 2027E. The downward trend in SG&A margin suggests improving cost discipline and efficiency gains over the forecast period.

**EBITDA Margin**  
EBITDA margin declined from 32.6% in 2022 to 27.1% in 2025, but is expected to rebound sharply to 46.4% by 2027E. This anticipated margin expansion points to significant profitability improvement, likely driven by revenue growth leverage and better cost control.
